newsitem.title: UK: Rexam sells five units for 18 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Rexam sells five units for 18 mln stg.

text.p: British paper and packaging group Rexam Plc said on Thursday that it had sold five businesses for a combined 18 million stg, bringing total proceeds from its sell-off programme to 87 million.
The company said the five businesses had combined sales of 56 million stg last year and operating losses of 5.6 million with assets including disposal provisions of 17.5 million.
The latest dispoals included Rexam Dispensers, Rexam Cartons and Flexible Packaging and, in the U.S., Rexam Cartons and Rexam Flexible Packaging.
